nom: La Roche-Posay Anthelios Glow Sunscreen SPF 35

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers say the glow finish doesn't add extra grease and doesn't feel clogging, though the shine can look more oily-looking than some with oily skin want.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers describe the formula as light, creamy and hydrating, giving a healthy glow to skin that otherwise looked dull, though very dry patches may still need a separate moisturizer.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report the glow looks shiny on their skin without feeling greasy, though a couple caution that the luminous finish may not be the most flattering choice for oily-combination skin.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including some with rosacea or lupus-related sun sensitivity, consistently report no irritation, stinging or breakouts, and several value that it is fragrance-free.

concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination skin say the glow finish can look shiny without actually feeling greasy, and it doesn't add extra oiliness on top of naturally oily skin; one reviewer nonetheless found her face got sticky and oily by the end of the day.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers, including some with dry skin, describe the sunscreen as hydrating and moisturizing rather than heavy or tacky; one notes that dry patches may still need a separate moisturizer underneath.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers, including some who are acne-prone or usually break out from sunscreen, consistently report no new breakouts or clogged pores with this formula, even with repeated use.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea, lupus-related sun sensitivity or general sensitivity report no irritation, stinging or flare-ups from this sunscreen, with one noting it was gentler than a higher-SPF product that used to irritate her skin.

aspects.libelle: Shimmer can look glittery, not glowy
Limited shade range fits some tones poorly
Blends in with no white cast
SPF 35 feels low to some users

extraits.titre: Works great but skin looks oily!
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The Anthelios UV Glow Sunscreen SPF 35 is an awesome product. It is one of the few tinted sunscreens I've tried that leaves no cast. I've been using this product for about 8 weeks and there has been no irritation or breakouts. It was also easy to apply and blend in to my skin. I love that it is compact, so I can take it everywhere. The one thing I really don't like though, is that it leaves my skin super oily. Even though my skin has a great glow for a few hours, as the day goes on, my face gets sticky and oily. Overall, Its a decent product and I would recommend it. I just wish it didn't make my skin so oily.

extraits.titre: A bit too glowy for me
extraits.texte: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This stuff is very shimmery and ends up I think making me look too oily without powder. I like the high spf so I may use this too layer under make up in the summer but I feel like it would better as a body sunscreen. I have been using it on my neck/decolletage area and hands and that has been working well. Also, although it does make my combo/oily skin look shiney, it doesn't feel greasy and does absorb well. If you have dry skin and are going for a glowy look , it could work for you but it was a bit too much for me.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am usually not a fan of tinted sunscreen but this one was actually nice and wore well thru the day. It has a slight tint so your skin does shine through. There's also no greasy feeling after applying which is rare to find do someone who has oily/combo skin like me. I made the mistake once of putting too much on and it felt very heavy and didn't blend well so a little goes a long way! I'll probably replenish this once it's out since I love the brand and how my skin didn't feel clogged after wearing all day!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I normally don't wear sunscreen unless I'm outside for a long time because they always break me out and clog my pores. Luckily this didn't do that, so I can definitely see this becoming my summer go to for on the go skin. I definitely need a lighter color for winter, but this will be perfect to give my skin a glow up this summer.

extraits.titre: I highly recommend it"s my new favorite product
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This glow sunscreen is supposed to improve your skin's radiance over time but I haven't been using it long enough to attest to that. What I can say is it gives you a beautiful instant glow the minute you put it on. You can use this as a stand alone product because it has a tint which helps even out your skin a bit and will leave you with gorgeous naturally glowing skin. You can also use it under your make up which still gives you you an amazing glow and sun protection. I've used it both ways and absolutely love it. It leaves my dry skin feeling hydrated and it feels good on its super lightweight, my skin looks so good after applying this I'm so in love with it. This is now one of my top new favorite products and I highly recommend it, I look forward to using it daily.

extraits.titre: Excellent Sunscreen With My Preferred SPF
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this La Roche-Posay Daily Glow Sunscreen. My face can get irritated from 50 SPF, especially when my butterfly rash is active, which is when I need sun protection the most. The La Roche-Posay Daily Glow Sunscreen with SPF 35 is perfect; not only does it give my face the protection and moisture it requires, it also doesn't irritate my skin. I love the glow it provides; it isn't wet looking or shiny, nor does it look like your face received a spray-on tan. The La Roche-Posay Daily Glow, for me, doubles as a primer - no pilling! I can't think of a single negative. It's great!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This sunscreen feels super light weight and hydrating. The glow it gives you is absolutely amazing and not too much! It doesnt leave your skin feeling very sticky either, which is usually a problem with a lot of other sunscreens. This is one of the only brands that will not cause breakouts for me as a very sensitive skin girly!
